newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: FIFTY-SIX PCT OF ARGENTINE FIRMS SEE DEMAND RISE.
newsitem.headline: FIFTY-SIX PCT OF ARGENTINE FIRMS SEE DEMAND RISE.

text.p: A survey by Argentina's official statistics institute shows 56 percent of businesses believe demand for their products will rise in the third quarter from the same period in 1996, Ambito Financiero newspaper reported Wednesday.
The INDEC survey indicated 37 percent predicted no change in demand, while seven percent forecast demand would fall.
The newspaper did not indicate when the poll was taken or how many firms were surveyed.
On Tuesday, Industry Minister Alieto Guadagni predicted industrial production for the year would be up eight percent. ((-- Gary Regenstreif, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0618))
